### Conditional figures settled
- **Insurance allowance** (`4363893e`, contract_ext_deferral_agreement_months): the published CPI corpus uses the same vocabulary as the contract factor. Statuses are pending verification / compliant / lapse notice / force-placed / closed (`dbab18db`, schema), and notices are first and second lapse notices. The record is `compliant`, and its only lapse notice (2025-05-16) is not later than 2025-10-20. So the tier is the per-request maximum, 2. **Settled.** The deferral count of 2 is unchanged.
- **Recovery review charge** (`a56b6ea1`, contract_ext_hardship_extension_charge): the recovery corpus defines `recalled` as a closed outcome with recall reason "account brought current" (`8609c1f9` §3, `f149a16d`), and there is no reinstated case. So the charge is +10.00. **Settled.** The fee of 43.97 is unchanged.
- No published cpi, recovery, gap, deficiency, vsc or dealer document states a rule on hardship extensions, late charges or deferral counts that conflicts with the contract corpus. A grep of all non-contract corpora for hardship / late charge / extension / review-day terms tied to the contract found only gap and recovery rules about their own products, and those don't apply to this world.

### Verdicts
KB-BIJECTION **PASS**, KB-EXPLICIT **PASS** (round-1 text stands). No source-side item.
